assets.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG isometric game environment prop, not a mockup: a luxurious Pepero Day chocolate-stick celebration monument, orthographic isometric camera 30 degree elevation, visible top and two sides, no perspective distortion. One cohesive free-standing sculpture on a low oval polished cocoa-brown plinth with thin champagne-gold trim. Tall elegantly fanned chocolate dipped biscuit sticks, ivory chocolate and strawberry pink sticks, delicate edible gold stripes, satin burgundy bow, a few small wrapped ivory gifts around the base, sculptural heart made of chocolate at center. Extremely polished cozy 3D game asset with beautiful beveled forms, fine material detail, warm baked soft lighting and ambient occlusion, clear silhouette readable at 320 pixels. Chic boutique patisserie art direction, restrained cocoa / warm cream / dusty strawberry / champagne gold palette. Full isolated object centered with generous transparent margins, absolutely no background scene, no floor outside the plinth, no UI, no characters, no text or logo, no Halloween objects. Wide landscape canvas. This actual asset will be composited into an isometric campus game.

Production transparent PNG game asset. Single cohesive asset, landscape image.
